named_premises: H_moral is modeled by a concrete 2x2 matrix representation.
The sign operator is the Pauli-Z matrix sigma-hat = [[1,0],[0,-1]], i.e., entries a=1, b=0, c=0, d=-1.
For a real 2x2 matrix [[a,b],[c,d]], Hermiticity is represented by symmetry b=c.
The encoding faithfully represents the intended domain; any formal-to-world identification needs an independently warranted bridge.
receipt: The Pauli-Z sign operator is Hermitian and has eigenvalues +1 and -1.

obstructions.reason: The derivation fails at the bridge from a pure two-dimensional sign operator to actual moral orientation as a binary, quantized, measurable quantum observable; A0 + P-IMAGO do not license that step.
